decisions.reason: It has a dedicated product page and builds on established plug-ins, indicating results likely at or above aspirations and low uncertainty.
The digital twin service is strategically relevant but only mentioned on the website, so its early results are uncertain; organizational slack allows carrying it while monitoring.
Authentication service is close to existing offers but has only a brief mention, suggesting possible below-aspiration performance that may trigger search, though slack counsels keeping it for now.
The open GIS framework is a product line but lacks a dedicated page, so its performance is uncertain and not yet clearly above aspirations; slack allows continued development.
The identity service has an active launch message and is close to established GIS applications, indicating likely acceptable performance relative to aspirations.
